BackSyncStageId.description: The ID of the pipeline stage from which changes are back-synced to a development environment. This is a relationship field.

CheckDeployCompletionDate.description: The date and time when a validate-only deployment completed.

CheckDeployDate.description: The date and time when a validate-only deployment started.

CheckDeployRequestInfoId.description: The ID of the DevopsRequestInfo record tracking the status of the deployment. This is a relationship field.

CheckDeployStatus.description: The current status of the deployment. The default value is NEW.

DeployCompletionDate.description: The date and time when the deployment operation completed.

DeployRequestInfoId.description: The ID of the DevopsRequestInfo record tracking the status of the full deployment. This is a relationship field.

DeployStatus.description: The current status of the deployment operation. The default value is NEW.

DeploymentDate.description: The date and time when the deployment started.

DeploymentIdentifier.description: A unique identifier for the deployment.

DevopsPipelnStgPromId.description: The ID of the associated pipeline stage promotion record. This is a relationship field.

EndRevisionCounter.description: The revision counter value representing the end state of the source control after this deployment.

IsCheckDeploy.description: Indicates whether this is a validate-only deployment. The default value is false.

IsFullDeploy.description: Indicates whether all changes in the branch is deployed instead of just the changes. The default value is false.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record indirectly, for example, through a list view or related record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, and LastReferenceDate isn't null, the user accessed this record or list view indirectly.

Name.description: The name of the environment deployment record.

RunTests.description: A comma-separated list of specific Apex tests to run if TestLevel is set to RunSpecifiedTests.

StartRevisionCounter.description: The revision counter value representing the starting state of the source control before this deployment.

Status.description: The overall status of the deployment operation. The default value is NEW.

TargetDeployOrgId.description: The ID of the target DevopsEnvironment where the change is deployed. This is a relationship field.

TestLevel.description: Specifies which Apex tests to run during the deployment. The default value is Default.
